eval.description: Anthropic experimental single-turn over-refusal eval paired with the higher-difficulty violative set. Benign prompts are rewritten with elaborate justifications and academic framing so older models over-refuse more often (English only; same policy-area counts as the violative twin). Cards report the over-refusal rate with and without extended thinking.
eval.summary: Measures how often the model refuses safe requests that include detailed justifications and academic framing.
eval.saturatedReason: An experimental Anthropic set. Anthropic says it changes or retires such sets as models saturate them.

versions.changes: Experimental synthetic set; Anthropic notes the prompt sets may change or be retired as they saturate.

scores.description: The model declined a benign prompt that should have been answered.

metrics.description: Share of higher-difficulty benign prompts the model over-refused.
